summary: Unchanged empty replication receipts and settled first-sync observations check committed state on readers before borrowing the SQLite writer. Changed receipts and due freshness checkpoints still recheck and write under the writer.

replay.detail: Envelope and signature admission are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Wire contracts, exact process-local last-seen times and the existing 17.5-second receipt checkpoint interval are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Persisted checkpoints and restart behavior are unchanged. Concurrent durable changes invalidate process-local extensions of older checkpoints.
